categories.main_business_segments: SL Corporation primarily operates in the automotive parts industry, manufacturing automotive lamps, electrification parts such as E-Shifters and shift levers, mirrors, and electronic components. The company also engages in new business areas including aviation mobility parts, robotics, and construction machinery parts. Its business is divided into lamp, electrification, and other segments, serving major OEMs like Hyundai, Kia, GM, Ford, and Geely.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced automotive lighting technologies including LED headlamps, projection-type LED lamps, and innovative optical modules like MLA (Micro Lens Array). It employs OEM production methods with a focus on modularization and integration of components such as front-end modules. R&D efforts emphasize optical design, electronic system integration, sensor fusion, and electrification technologies, supported by in-house research centers and advanced manufacturing facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SL Corporation's primary customers are global automotive OEMs including Hyundai, Kia, GM, Ford, and Geely. The company supplies automotive lamps, electrification parts, mirrors, and electronic modules to these manufacturers. Its products are used in passenger vehicles across multiple regions, with a focus on premium and mass-market vehicles, including electric and autonomous vehicle segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and sales presence in South Korea, the United States, China, India, Poland, Brazil, and other regions. It has 19 subsidiaries and affiliates across these key markets, enabling localized production and supply to major automotive hubs. The geographic coverage supports both domestic Korean OEMs and international customers in North America, Europe, China, India, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: SL Corporation functions primarily as a Tier 1 automotive parts supplier, operating midstream in the supply chain. It manufactures and supplies key components directly to OEMs under an OEM production model. The company also engages in joint ventures and partnerships to enhance modular assembly capabilities, positioning itself as a critical supplier in the automotive manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes expanding electrification product lines, advancing automotive lighting technologies, and entering new mobility sectors such as urban air mobility and robotics. R&D initiatives prioritize development of high-resolution LED modules, sensor-integrated lighting systems, and battery management systems. SL Corporation invests heavily in innovation to maintain competitiveness amid rapid industry shifts toward electrification, autonomy, and connectivity.
categories.revenue_model: SL Corporation generates revenue primarily through the sale of automotive parts and modules under OEM contracts. Revenue streams include product sales of lamps, electrification components, mirrors, and electronic modules. The company also earns licensing fees and royalties from technology transfer agreements and joint ventures. Sales are conducted via direct OEM supply, exports through subsidiaries, and partnerships with module assemblers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SL Corporation is positioned as a leading global automotive parts supplier, ranked among the top 100 global suppliers by Automotive News and Berylls. It competes with other Tier 1 suppliers specializing in automotive lighting and electrification components. The company’s competitive advantages include strong OEM relationships, advanced R&D capabilities, and a diversified global manufacturing footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, SL Corporation reported consolidated revenues of approximately 4.84 trillion KRW with a 15.9% year-over-year growth and operating profit growth of 95.1%. The company maintains a solid financial structure with total assets of about 3.24 trillion KRW and a strong equity ratio of 62.1%. Its growth trajectory is supported by expanding electrification product sales and increasing LED lamp adoption in premium vehicles.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SL Corporation emphasizes premium value innovation by delivering high-quality, technologically advanced automotive lighting and electrification products. Its differentiation lies in proprietary optical technologies, integration of sensor and communication functions in lighting, and strong customization capabilities for OEMs. The company’s global production network and sustained R&D investment enable it to offer competitive pricing, superior quality, and innovative solutions aligned with evolving automotive trends.
